verdict.rationale: First-party docs state that Hoppscotch Community Edition is free and open-source under the MIT License, and the public GitHub repository is in the pack. Community members independently describe it as an open-source Postman alternative. The caveat is that it is open core: Enterprise features such as SAML SSO and audit logs are separate, and community reports say some contributions are kept out of the open version. Missing for 10: evidence that Enterprise Edition source is readable under an open license, and direct evidence of the repository's license file.
